mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT booked_on FROM transactions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND booked_on IS NOT NULL ORDER BY booked_on DESC
SELECT id,user_id,account_id,merchant,category,amount_minor,booked_on FROM transactions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id,user_id,account_id,merchant,category,amount_minor,booked_on FROM transactions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND booked_on>=#{start} AND booked_on<#{end} ORDER BY booked_on,id

SELECT merchant,COUNT(*) AS occurrences,MIN(booked_on) AS first_seen,MAX(booked_on) AS last_seen, MIN(-amount_minor) AS min_amount_minor,MAX(-amount_minor) AS max_amount_minor FROM transactions WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND amount_minor<0 GROUP BY merchant HAVING COUNT(*)>=2
